layout: Bulb board: masthead with the best-bet line, a full-width quick-capture bar, then a two-column board (idea list left, sticky map right; one column on phones with the map first). Rows are aligned columns: idea, stage, stars, last change; a coloured stage edge on each row.
signature: The stage × rating map: every idea is a pixel square (the bulb icon's pixel motif) placed by stage (rows, raw to shipped, with parked and killed off the path) and gut rating (columns, warming towards 5 stars). Stage labels filter the list; hovering a square lights up its row.
mood: Warm workshop light: ideas start cool and warm up as they move from raw to active, then turn green when shipped.
